summary: The history of one record: who did what and when, with comments, reviews and change events in one chronological thread.
not_for: A list of records the reader chooses among: collection.row.resource.

slots.when: Where the page holds other sections: 履歴, コメント or the object's own word for it.
The person or the system that acted; a link where the build holds a view of that person, plain text otherwise.
When it happened: a relative phrase for a recent entry with the full time in title, a date and time otherwise.
What happened, as a short phrase with its values: ステータスを確認待ちから出荷手配待ちに変更.
The entry is a review: its stars, with the number in the accessible name.

rules.rule: Each entry states who acted, when and what; a change names the property and both values.
Comments and change events share one chronological thread.
An action the reader takes on the record adds its entry to the thread.
A review is an entry: the reviewer, the date, the stars with the review's title, and the text.

evidence.says: Each entry holds the author, the time since the update and either the comment or a list of property changes such as ステータス を Closed から Reopened に変更.
Comments (author, date, body) and event lines (added this to the milestone, closed this as completed) run in one thread.
Close events and reference events follow the first comment in time order, each with its actor and its age.
Each comment carries a header with the author and the timestamp above its body.

evidence.source: Product pages of Amazon.co.jp, 楽天市場, Yahoo!ショッピング, アスクル and 価格.com, captured 2026-11 (research/20261113-production-ui-ooui/corpus/anatomy_shop_product.json)
evidence.says: Reviews are printed on 5 of 6 pages; one review holds its title, stars, date, body and name.
